storyCards.headline: Hey Ya: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Outkast's "Hey Ya" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 32 weeks on the chart.

Hey Ya was released in 2003.

Album: Speakerboxxx/The Love Below (2003).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
